mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate revenues and earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) above 1% MoM signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 1% MoM and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and boosts corporate investments, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases over three consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals a strengthening demand side of the economy, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both increase and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 3.5% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) below -1% MoM signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which reduces corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO < -1% MoM and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the triggered instances.
